note: Machine-specific CPU inference timings, not end-to-end capture performance; still-image audit, not temporal events.
threshold_policy: User-requested inclusive confidence >= 0.80; not selected or tuned using these test images.
test_set: The same 108 held-out participant-02 images used in phone-export-v2.json; already inspected during model development, not a new independent evaluation.

reference_report.note: Historical 0.4.5 results are unchanged; see that report for previous runtime counts.

limitations: A higher threshold reduces recall: not all phones are detected.
Zero false positives on 30 negative images does not establish zero false positives in production.
Image-level counts are distinct from IoU-matched box counts and temporal PHONE_DETECTED events.
